print("Initial bottom panel symbols:")

    current_hashes = {}

            min_r = min([p[0] for p in node['boundary']])
            min_c = min([p[1] for p in node['boundary']])
            current_hashes[(min_r, min_c)] = node['hash'][:8]
    print(f"\nAfter UP #{i+1}:")
    for pos, h in sorted(current_hashes.items()):
        changed = "CHANGED" if h != initial_hashes.get(pos, "") else ""
        print(f"  pos {pos}: {h} {changed}")
